metadata.title: Email Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating email as a trusted, identity-bearing, and accountable communication channel.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Email infrastructure, mail transfer systems, mailboxes, routing services, and client access mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing baseline trust assumptions for institutional email systems.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Initial access attempts initiated through email communication.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Credential access via email-based phishing and social engineering.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Defense evasion by abusing trusted email channels.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Phishing via email messages and attachments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Email collection or abuse of mailbox contents following compromise.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong authentication for mail access and submission.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access control enforcement to protect email content.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Message monitoring and inspection to detect malicious or abusive activity.

metadata.remarks: Email Core defines the foundational trust properties required to operate email as a reliable institutional communication channel. This pattern establishes baseline assumptions about identity binding, message delivery, and accountability, without addressing advanced threat protection or data governance.

components.title: Email Identity Binding
components.description: Binds email messages to authenticated and accountable sender identities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email access and submission are tied to authenticated user or service identities.
Credential management supports accountable use of email identities.
Cryptographic mechanisms may be used to bind identity assertions to email messages.
Email accounts are provisioned and managed to maintain accurate identity association.

components.title: Email Delivery Assurance
components.description: Ensures email messages are routed, transmitted, and delivered without unauthorized modification.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Transmission confidentiality and integrity protect email in transit.
Email routing mechanisms prevent unauthorized redirection or alteration.
Boundary protection mechanisms constrain exposure of email services.

components.title: Email Accountability
components.description: Provides auditability and traceability of email usage and message handling.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email-related events are defined and captured for audit purposes.
Email audit records are generated for significant security-relevant events.
Audit review supports investigation and accountability for email activity.
